notes.title: bugfix 2025/5/24
notes.content:
1. Fixed a bug that caused the text to be displayed incorrectly when running the game on a Spanish or German operating system.
2. Used new fonts
3. Now you can play directly to the extra chapter

notes.title: Update 2022/06/20
notes.content:
1. Update the background story line of the game, now you can unlock part of the story line after completing the new ending
2. Added multiple transitions animations
3. Added a secret mission game scene of the scientist
4. Added a secret mission game scene for prisoner
5. Added 5 new achievements

notes.title: New Update: The Power of Fire
notes.content: Updated with new uses for fire in the game, you can now throw oil lamp or torch out to ignite objects. The combination of vodka and torch together will have a more powerful effect and can be used to repel wild dogs.

notes.title: Update 2022/6/6: Cannibal token
notes.content: A new item from the cannibals has been added. You now have a chance to exchange it for a cannibal token in the hands of a cannibal. Survivors with cannibal tokens will be able to pass through cannibal areas safely the next time they pass through them.

notes.title: Update: The consequences of using the nuclear bomb
notes.content:
A new interactive feature has been added.  After this feature update, when you detonate the nuclear bomb you accidentally picked up, you will find that the scene has changed a bit when you pass through it the second time... 

For example, you can detonate the nuclear bomb in the cannibal area, and the next time you pass through the cannibal area, no cannibals will appear to trouble you.

notes.title: Update 23/5/2022
notes.content:
Bug fixes:

1. Hospital scene clipping bug
2. Unable to read and save files on Mac OS
3. UI display is not clear on some machines

Optimization: 

1. Ending animation can be skipped
2. Add skip message button
3. You can choose not to generate the ending psychological test

notes.title: Updated April 29, 2022
notes.content: Fixed the bug that big spider is sometimes no longer afraid of lights.
